class.name: GameplayTag
class.brief_description: A canonical name for a gameplay state, definition, or event.
class.description: Use a gameplay tag to name a concept shared by several systems. A path such as [code]state.control.stun[/code] matches itself and its ancestors [code]state.control[/code] and [code]state[/code]. Export a [GameplayTag] to choose it with the Inspector picker. The saved Resource stores the canonical path. Compare tag values with [method matches_exact].

method.name: as_container
method.description: Returns an independent container holding this tag as its only explicit member. An invalid tag produces an empty container.

method.name: find
method.description: Looks up [param name] in the project catalog, including implied ancestors and rename redirects. Returns [code]null[/code] for an unknown name or invalid path.

method.name: from_name
method.description: Creates a tag from [param name] and applies project rename redirects. The path can be absent from the catalog. Returns [code]null[/code] for empty paths, empty segments, or characters outside ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and segment-separating dots.

method.name: get_tag_name
method.description: Returns the lowercase dot-separated path, or an empty name if the tag is invalid.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the tag holds a valid path. Validity describes path syntax. Use [method find] to check registration.

method.name: leaf_name
method.description: Returns the final path segment, or an empty name if the tag is invalid.

method.name: match_depth
method.description: Counts the whole segments this tag shares with [param other], starting at the root. Returns [code]0[/code] when the roots differ or either operand is invalid or missing.

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns whether this tag is equal to or descends from [param required]. A stun can satisfy a general control-impairment requirement. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid or missing operand.

method.name: matches_exact
method.description: Returns whether both tags hold the same valid canonical path. Returns [code]false[/code] if either operand is invalid or missing.

method.name: parent
method.description: Returns the direct parent of this tag. Returns [code]null[/code] for a root tag or an invalid tag.
